'''MELEK Pinboard''' is the picture side of MELEK, at [https://melek.salon/pin melek.salon/pin]. It shows photos as a wall of thumbnails, the way Pinterest and Instagram do. It is the '''Photos (Pinboard)''' tool in the melek.salon post editor. Part of [[Posting on MELEK]]. The Pinboard is in alpha.

== What a pin is ==
A pin is a picture on the wall: one you posted, or one you saved from a MELEK post or anywhere on the web. A saved picture always keeps a link back to where it came from. Every pin page gives you the Markdown to put that picture into a MELEK post.

== How to: pin a picture ==
# Go to melek.salon/pin, or open '''Photos (Pinboard)''' in the post editor's Creation tools panel.
# Paste the picture's address into the first box.
# Add a title if you like, and your MELEK name.
# Choose '''Pin it'''.

== How to: save every picture from a MELEK post ==
Paste the address of a MELEK post instead of a picture, and choose '''Pin it'''. All of the post's pictures are saved to the wall, each linked to the post.

== How to: put a pin in your post ==
# Open the pin.
# Copy the Markdown shown on its page.
# Paste it into the body of your post. See [[Images and Video in Posts]].
Photo posts go in the '''Photos''' category. See [[Post Categories on MELEK]].

== How to: save from any web page ==
Drag the '''Save to MELEK''' button from the Pinboard to your browser's bookmarks bar. On any page, click the bookmark to save a picture from it to the Pinboard.
